role: positive-spectral gapless control for the CORR-I Yang-Mills vacuum-boundary experiment
interpretation: This is a synthetic mathematical control, not lattice data.
It is exactly positive-spectral and genuinely gapless because the spectral support reaches E=0.
It is normalized and early-time matched to the massive control to make the chamber comparison nontrivial.
The experiment tests whether CORR-I distinguishes a gapped exponential baseline from a legitimate gapless positive-spectral baseline under the same frozen chamber settings.
